config.output_compression.enabled_help: Shortens long tool output before it reaches the model and so saves tokens. Error messages are kept when the option below is on.
help.agent.output_compression.repetitive: Replaces recurring pieces of text with short references without changing their order. Saves tokens on highly repetitive output.
Maximum number of references created per output. More entries find more repetitions but need more room for the dictionary.
Longer outputs are not processed with this method, to save computing time.
A piece of text is only replaced if it occurs at least this many times.
Shorter pieces of text are never replaced, because the reference would then take more room than the text.
The result is only used if it is at least this many percent shorter than the original.
Tables with more rows are not rendered in the compact TOON format.
The compact table form is only used if it is at least this many percent shorter than the JSON.
